author: Unknown
date: Set c. 1100 BC; written later (dating debated)
overview: Naomi loses her husband and sons, and returns home bitter, with her Moabite daughter-in-law Ruth, who refuses to leave her. Ruth works in the fields of Boaz, a relative, who acts as their "kinsman-redeemer" and marries her. Their great-grandson is King David.
storyPlace: Set in the time of the Judges. It links the story to King David's family line.
